hyperparameters.name: data augmentation
hyperparameters.value: 10 degrees, and small random brightness and contrast jittering

methods.name: ResNet34 one-hot
methods.description: This model uses a standard approach for categorical classification, where each class is treated independently. Masking levels are predicted independently using standard softmax and cross-entropy loss to predict one-hot encodings.

methods.name: ResNet34 multi-hot
methods.description: This model accounts for the ordinal relation between masking levels using multi-hot encodings.

methods.name: F1-score
methods.description: a common metric to assess the performance in information retrieval

methods.name: odds ratio
methods.description: a measurement often used in clinical studies

methods.name: odds ratio computation
methods.description: The odds ratio is computed relative to a reference group, in this case the reference is the first quartile g1, as ORi=Oi/O1.
